HomePage.title: Welcome, fellow otaku 🌸
HomePage.content: Select an anime from the list on the left to view its details. Use the search bar to find your favorite titles.

About.title: About
About.paragraph_1: This is a simple app to search for anime, offering users a clean interface to explore their favorite titles and discover new ones. It is developed as part of the React course at
About.paragraph_2: , with a focus on practicing key concepts like component-based architecture, dynamic routing, asynchronous API interactions, and modern styling using TailwindCSS.
